# Goalkeeper Royale (real run fixture)

The game-design and title-strategy a real `/web-game-factory:new-game` run produced on
2026-10-01 (run `new-game-20261001-043218-bb3119`, agent design author), before game-design
1.5.0 had an experience contract. The game built from them could not be understood by a
first-time player. `test_design_experience` holds the experience checks against this design
as its authors would have stated the contract from its own content.
